fusions.name: Sleighride
fusions.desc: Rushes you up to 8 tiles toward the target on a barbed line that deals 13 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Over the Horizon
fusions.desc: Looses a long-held shot at an enemy up to 10 tiles away that deals 28 damage, rising to 2 times that at full reach. It is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Held Breath
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Full Draw
fusions.desc: The moment your stamina is full, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 10 seconds.
